hero.title: From regulated utility to intelligent energy orchestrator
hero.lede: How a utility meets record demand, keeps the lights on and stays affordable: engineer with AI, operate with AI, decide and act with AI — governed, secured and assured by one control plane across every layer, with people in command of the grid.
hero.meta: Demo operator: your Utility — a generic, synthetic reference profile · 3.2M electric customers, 1.1M gas customers, 9.4 GW generation, 690 substations (synthetic).

why.headline: The grid is becoming the platform for growth, electrification and resilience — and it has to change faster than it ever has.

rows.title: The world it powers
rows.text: Data centres, electrification and EVs bring demand growth back after two flat decades.

rows.title: The pressure on the system
rows.text: Reliability, wildfire and storms, affordability and regulation all tighten at once.
